name: Net speed
author: mulm
description: Live download and upload speed in the bar, read straight from /proc with no helper processes.

barWidget.description: ↓ download and ↑ upload per second on the interfaces that carry your default route. Hover for peaks and totals; click for the network panel, right-click for a speed test.

schema.label: Unit
schema.description: Bytes per second (KB/s, MB/s; 1024-based) or bits per second (Kb/s, Mb/s; 1000-based).

schema.label: Interfaces
schema.description: Comma-separated interface names, e.g. wlan0. Empty follows the default route, so switching between Wi-Fi and Ethernet just works.
